answer: In this PoA network, reputation decays exponentially with a defined temporal half-life, so past endorsements lose weight unless an identity continues to provide honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality is propagated through reciprocity-weighted trust; a freshly spawned sybil has few credible incoming paths and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality. Like a ridge separated from a canyon by karst, an isolated identity cannot bridge the trust graph or meet consensus thresholds without sustained, verifiable participation.
